Subject: Pilot top-up proposal — short window to close Q3

Katherine —

Great conversation earlier. FinLytics has been a fantastic pilot partner and I know the team is close to an internal signoff. If helpful to move this over the finish line before quarter-end, we can offer a one-time token top-up tied to a 90-day extension of the pilot and a firm 12-month committed start date if the legal/finance approvals land.

Proposed one-time offer: 200k extra tokens credited to your account on activation + waived onboarding invoice for September (one-time).

If you want to proceed, I need an internal approval from Rishi + a quick PO from procurement. I attached a redline SOW and a short approval sheet for finance to populate.

Next steps:
- Katherine: confirm if procurement can sign PO by 9/16
- FinLytics procurement: confirm billing contact and PO cadence
- Us: get credit approved and drop a final SOW + DocuSign link

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Rishi —

Quick context: Marissa is requesting a one-time 200k token credit to accelerate a close with FinLytics. Procurement can turn a PO by 9/16 if we supply PO language and a signed SOW. The ask will bump short-term revenue recognition but is expected to convert to a committed annual contract (deal FL-2026-092).

Attached is the credit approval sheet (costed) and the suggested PO line: 
- PO line: "One-time promotional credit: 200,000 inference tokens (non-refundable), applied as credit on account upon execution of SOW"

Finance notes on the sheet: the credit impact is modeled as a contra-revenue promotion and would reduce recognized revenue in Q3 by the amount allocated to the pilot. We still recommend proceeding given the high probability of attach.

Thanks for the context and the modelling. I prefer minimizing revenue impact but want to keep momentum. A couple of adjustments:

1) Reduce one-time credit from 200k tokens to 150k tokens.
2) Make the credit conditional: credited only after FinLytics signs a 12-month committed agreement and final SOW is executed within 30 days of PO.
3) Require a statement of commitment in the PO: "Customer commits to a one-year paid term beginning on activation date; promotional credit applied upon SOW execution."

If legal flags anything, loop in Lauren. If finance needs an extra approval route, approve this as an executive discretionary promo. Monica, can you confirm on the finance routing?
